full_prompt_en: A square architectural concept drawing shows several bold red circular platforms wrapped around a tall central column within a lightly sketched interior. The page is warm cream, with thin gray construction lines extending well beyond the depicted structure. At the top, a half-round red platform floats near the upper left, its curved front edge outlined in dark ink. Below it, a broader red level projects toward the viewer, while another smaller platform circles the column lower down. A red rectangular bridge extends from the middle level toward the right, crossing in front of gray structural outlines and joining an implied adjoining volume. Near the lower center, a dark winding stair climbs around the column, its treads and railing shown in quick precise strokes. The column itself is gray and vertically ribbed, passing through all the red plates into a shallow base. To the right, pale gray beams, rails, and gridded walls recede in perspective; to the left, mostly unfilled guide lines describe open space. Numerous vertical and horizontal measurement marks remain visible through the composition, giving the impression of a working drawing rather than a polished final rendering. The red planes are matte and slightly mottled, while black cross-hatching adds weight beneath their projecting edges. Lighting is represented by the light page ground and selective darker undersides rather than a single realistic sun. No legible dimensions or words can be made out. The overall composition is dynamic yet rigorously organized, with three stacked curved accents, a central vertical spine, and many thin guides balancing energy against precision.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑概念草图呈现几层大胆的红色圆形平台，绕着高中央立柱置于轻描的室内结构里。纸面为暖奶油色，细灰色构造线远远伸出被描绘的结构。顶部，一片半圆红平台漂在左上附近，弯曲前缘由深墨线圈出。其下，更宽的红色楼层朝观者伸出，较低处还有一层较小平台环住立柱。一道红色矩形连桥从中层向右延伸，跨过灰色结构轮廓前方，接入暗示性的邻接体量。下方中央附近，一道深色旋转楼梯围柱攀升，踏步和栏杆用迅速而精确的笔痕画出。立柱本身是灰色并带竖向肋纹，穿过所有红板，落入浅基座。右侧，浅灰色梁、栏杆和网格墙按透视后退；左侧，大多未填色的辅助线描出开放空间。许多竖向与水平测量痕贯穿构图，使它像工作图而非光洁的最终渲染。红色平面哑光且略有斑驳，黑色排线在悬挑底边增加重量。照明由浅色纸底和选择性的深色底面表现，而非单一写实太阳。无法辨认任何尺寸数字或文字。整体构图动感却组织严谨，三层堆叠曲线重音、一条中央竖向主轴和众多细辅助线让能量与精确相互平衡。
style_prompt_en: The concept drawing combines translucent construction lines with a few opaque saturated red planes. Repeated curves are stacked against a central vertical axis, while long projecting bars and guide grids establish direction and measured depth. Cream paper remains widely exposed; fine black and gray linework alternates between exact perspective and lively unfinished searching marks. Dark hatchings under selected surfaces provide weight without full photorealistic shading. Matte pigment has slight grain and unevenness. The composition feels simultaneously provisional and decisive because faint guides coexist with strong color blocks. The overall effect is experimental, disciplined, and energetic, with drafting process itself visible as texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅概念图把半透明构造线与少数不透明的饱和红色平面结合。重复曲线围中央竖轴堆叠，长伸出横条和辅助网格建立方向与可测深度。奶油色纸张大面积裸露；细黑灰线条在精确透视与生动未完成的探索笔痕间变化。选定表面下方的深排线提供重量，无需完整照片式阴影。哑光色料带轻微颗粒和不均。微弱辅助线与强色块共存，使构图既像临时试探，又果断明确。整体效果实验性、严谨且富于能量，制图过程本身成为可见肌理。
theme_en: A sketch of red circular platforms and stairs around a central column
theme_zh: 中央立柱周围红色圆形平台与楼梯的草图
name: Bernard Tschumi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
